en: A sepia-toned portrait of a young man with dark wavy hair and a small mustache, dressed in an elaborate Renaissance-style costume with ruffled fabric, a high lace collar, ornate belt, and a richly patterned cloak draped over one shoulder. He faces the camera with a serious expression, holding the hilt of a sword. The image has a studio backdrop and includes faint printed credits along the lower edge.
